evidence.evidence_text: If the camera and sensors notice suspicious movements around the house after 10.00 pm and if an unknown user tries to enter through a door or window, ACTIVATE the anti-theft alarm and SEND notification to home users
WHEN there is a storm COVER the pool

responsibility_name: respond to failed alarm code entry attempts

evidence.evidence_text: When the alarm code is not entered correctly, connect the video door phone camera to the app and send notification to user

responsibility_name: Ensure the pellet tank is refilled before it runs out

evidence.evidence_text: When the sensor that detects the weight of the pellets inside the tank is less than 2 Kg, an automatic notification is sent to the set telephone number containing the message "Tank to Refill"

responsibility_name: have coffee ready at wake time

evidence.evidence_text: When the alarm goes off, the coffee machine turns on

responsibility_name: Have morning coffee ready at eight

evidence.evidence_text: If it's 8:00, turn on the electric coffee maker in the kitchen.
When a certain food is missing in the fridge, send a notification and add the product to the shopping list on the fridge LED.

If the smart beer dispenser detects that the content of the current boiler is less than 50% and the reserve stock is less than 2 boilers then it will be automatically added to the Google Home shopping list Refill Beer ” also sending a notification to the stored phone ""Added 'Recharge Beer' to Google shopping list"

responsibility_name: keep the household stocked with usual foods

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN user NOT at home IF the fridge is empty SEND the user an SMS reminding him to go shopping with the list of foods he usually eats

responsibility_name: Ensure comfortable room temperature before waking

evidence.evidence_text: Ten minutes before the alarm sounds, the air conditioner is activated and will switch off as soon as the room temperature is the one preset by the user.

responsibility_name: Ensure the room is warm after showering

evidence.evidence_text: When I finish taking a shower, turn on the stove in the room at 25°.
While the user is cooking using the hob, the hood switches on automatically.
If the time is between 18:00 - 23:00 and the temperature is below 17 degrees, the light goes on and the radiators go on.
If the time is between 18:00 - 23:00 and the temperature is below 17 degrees, the light goes on and the radiators go on.

responsibility_name: Keep sleeper warm during cold nights

evidence.evidence_text: If it is 24 and if the temperature is less than or equal to 5 degrees and if there is a weight of more than 20kg on the sofa, then set off an alarm clock and turn on the heater in bed.
